deps.edn.reason: The git floors on error, bytes, test and text point at repositories that are bundled here as kotoba.error, kotoba.bytes, kotoba.test and kotoba.text; they become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. :paths and :aliases are unchanged.

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the source and test paths.
